Remove a registered engine

Source: R/engine-registry.R
unregister_lsa_engine.Rd

unregister_lsa_engine() removes an engine from the registry for the rest of the session, so that lsa(engine = name) no longer finds it. It is mainly used to clean up an engine added with register_lsa_engine(). A removed built-in engine returns when the package is loaded again.

Usage

unregister_lsa_engine(name)

Arguments

name

Name of the engine.

Value

NULL, invisibly.

Conditions

Errors carry the class lagdynamics_error and lagdynamics_unknown_engine when no engine is registered under name.

See also

register_lsa_engine(), list_lsa_engines()

Examples

placeholder <- function(transitions, ...) {
  obs <- transitions$obs
  expected <- outer(rowSums(obs), colSums(obs)) / sum(obs)
  list(obs = obs, exp = expected, prob = obs / rowSums(obs),
       adj_res = obs * 0, p = obs * 0 + 1)
}
register_lsa_engine("placeholder", placeholder,
                    description = "Placeholder engine")
unregister_lsa_engine("placeholder")
list_lsa_engines()
#>                    name
#> 1         bidirectional
#> 2             classical
#> 3 nonparallel_dominance
#> 4    parallel_dominance
#> 5              two_cell
#>                                                            description requires
#> 1 Sackett's bidirectional / matched-pair test on the symmetrized table         
#> 2                    Bakeman & Quera classical lag sequential analysis         
#> 3       Sackett's non-parallel-dominance (observed-SE + binomial) test         
#> 4                      Sackett's parallel-dominance (expected-SE) test         
#> 5                  2x2 cell test (odds ratio, log-OR Wald z, Yule's Q)
